mapper.select: WITH t0 AS ( SELECT ID,ASS_YEAR FROM BIZ_COMPANY_GOAL WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ), t1 AS ( SELECT YEAR, NEW_CONTRACT_AMOUNT FROM BIZ_BUSINESS WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND ORG_ID = #{companyId} AND (YEAR, MONTH) IN ( SELECT YEAR, MAX(MONTH) FROM BIZ_BUSINESS WHERE ORG_ID = #{companyId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' GROUP BY YEAR ) ), t2 AS ( SELECT YEAR, REC_AMOUNT_ACC, PROFIT_AMOUNT_ACC FROM BIZ_FINANCE WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND ORG_ID = #{companyId} AND (YEAR, MONTH) IN ( SELECT YEAR, MAX(MONTH) FROM BIZ_FINANCE WHERE ORG_ID = #{companyId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' GROUP BY YEAR ) ), t3 AS ( SELECT YEAR, SUM(PRODUCT_AMOUNT) AS PRODUCT_AMOUNT_TOTAL FROM BIZ_PRODUCT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND ORG_ID = #{companyId} GROUP BY YEAR ) SELECT t0.ID AS id, t0.ASS_YEAR AS assYear, t1.NEW_CONTRACT_AMOUNT AS newContractTotalComp, t2.REC_AMOUNT_ACC AS incomeTotalComp, t2.PROFIT_AMOUNT_ACC AS profitTotalComp, t3.PRODUCT_AMOUNT_TOTAL AS proValueTotalComp, t4.ID AS id, t5.STATUS AS goalModifyStatus FROM t0 LEFT JOIN t1 ON t0.ASS_YEAR = t1.YEAR LEFT JOIN t2 ON t0.ASS_YEAR = t2.YEAR LEFT JOIN t3 ON t0.ASS_YEAR = t3.YEAR LEFT JOIN BIZ_COMPANY_GOAL t4 ON t0.ASS_YEAR = t4.ASS_YEAR LEFT JOIN BIZ_COMPANY_GOAL_MODIFY t5 ON t4.ID = t5.GOAL_ID AND t5.CREATE_TIME = (SELECT MAX(CREATE_TIME) FROM BIZ_COMPANY_GOAL_MODIFY WHERE t4.ID = GOAL_ID AND DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE') WHERE t4.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND t5.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ORDER BY t1.YEAR DESC
